ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white field (approx. 75-80%) with high-contrast low-intensity black borders and scattered focal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white lobes bifurcated by a dark central column; left lobe contains four distinct brownish-yellow sub-circular blobs in the mid-anterior region; black pigmentation concentrated on trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an acute vertex angle approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude rhythmic serrations; left lobe trailing edge displays irregular, higher-amplitude macro-indentations and uneven erosions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering from distal tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular black ring-scars visible on the white field of the right lobe; dense clusters of high-contrast calcified barnacles on the upper-left distal tip and right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct curvilinear black rake marks visible on the lower-right lobe surface and vertical linear disruptions on the left lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch on the upper-left trailing edge; localized brownish-yellow biological discoloration/staining on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of four yellow-hued circular spots arranged in a quasi-linear vertical sequence on the left lobe white field.
